finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts::the changed timeout behavior — reporting unbound_callback_message instead of the generic timeout when only nonce-less callbacks were seen — has no test
evidence: Verified against packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts (the setTimeout block branching on sawUnboundCallback, ~line 373) and packages/cli/test/login-callback.test.ts. The test file never uses fake timers (vi is not even imported), the 30s timeout is hardcoded with no injectable override, UNBOUND_CALLBACK_MESSAGE is only asserted as a 400 response body, and no test asserts any rejection of waitForCallback() — settledWithin(..., 50) only checks non-settlement. The timeout-message branch is genuinely untested; impact is limited to an unverified error-message selection, so minor.
